newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Two traffic policemen gunned down in Bogota.
newsitem.headline: Two traffic policemen gunned down in Bogota.

text.p: Three Colombian traffic policemen have been killed in the past six days, two of them on Tuesday, Bogota's El Espectador newspaper reported on Wednesday.

It said the two were shot and killed in the capital's downtown area after pulling over a red Mazda sedan to check the driver's papers. The two gunmen who opened fire from the car escaped, police said.
Another traffic cop was run down and killed by a city bus driver last Friday after the driver was ticketed for a minor infraction. The driver is under arrest.
